messages:
ashley (CEO): :wave: Heads-up — we’re doing a short company sync next Wednesday 9:00am PT (30m). Goal: align on Q2 launches, a quick incident summary, and a few ops callouts. Agenda below. Please drop any questions in this thread or add them to the doc: https://redwood.internal/sync/q2-sync-questions

maya (Product): Agenda looks good to me. Can we add a 3-min demo snippet for the new `Optimize` recommendations?
devon (Eng): +1 on the demo. Also can we call out the new default batching policy so teams know the rollout window?
liam (Design): Will capture a 1-slide visual for rollout impact.
jen (People Ops): Quick note — we’ll have closed captions and a short post-sync pulse survey. If you need accomodations, DM me.
ashley (CEO): Great — updated agenda: 1) Quick exec state (5m) 2) `Optimize` demo + Q/A (8m) 3) Dedicated rollout & default batching policy (7m) 4) Incident summary + mitigations (5m) 5) Q&A and next steps (5m). Recording link and clips will be posted after.
maya (Product): Question — for the default batching policy, will it be opt-in for Dedicated or auto-applied?
devon (Eng): Short answer: auto-applied for Hosted only, Dedicated customers will get a configurable flag. We’ll surface docs in the rollout notes.
jen (People Ops): Who is moderating Qs? We should triage live vs async.
liam (Design): I can moderate the Qs doc and flag anything design/UX related.
ashley (CEO): Thanks — @liam please own moderation. @devon can you paste the rollout doc in the thread after the sync?

***[MEETING HAPPENED — RECORDING POSTED BELOW]***

ops-bot: Recording uploaded: https://redwood-recordings.s3.amazonaws.com/1765004321-q2-signal-check.mp4 :record_button:
ops-bot: Clip: `Optimize-demo` https://redwood-recordings.s3.amazonaws.com/clips/1765004321-optimize-demo.mp4
ops-bot: Clip: `Batching-rollout` https://redwood-recordings.s3.amazonaws.com/clips/1765004321-batching-rollout.mp4

maya (Product): TL;DR takeaways: 1) `Optimize` beta opens in 2 weeks — limited access for now. 2) Default batching policy will lower per-token CPU by ~18% for hosted traffic. 3) We’ll run a Dedicated-safe rollout with a config flag and customer opt-in window.
devon (Eng): Incident brief: we had a 45m latency spike last Friday caused by a bad kernel selector regression. Mitigation: rolled back to last stable kernel and added an automated smoke test to catch the path. Action items: #1234 add kernel selector regression test, #1235 add alert on p95 mismatch vs baseline.
liam (Design): Visual note — we added a new banner in Console to show when default batching changes may affect latency vs cost tradeoffs. Screenshot in the doc above.
jen (People Ops): Survey link for attendees: https://forms.redwood.com/allhands-pulse — please take 90s to give feedback. We’ll use results for agenda tweaks.
ashley (CEO): Two org asks: 1) If you own customer-facing docs, please review the rollout page before EOD Tue. 2) Heads of eng/product: sync with your teams re: potential customer communications.
devon (Eng): Rollout doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/batching-rollout — posted. Please add comments; I’ll address inline.
maya (Product): I’ll schedule the limited beta invite list and share criteria by Monday.
liam (Design): Filed a small follow-on ticket to update the Console UX for the banner: #1240
jen (People Ops): Noted — will include the sync recording and clip links in this week’s digest.
ashley (CEO): Thanks everyone — solid meeting. If anyone has follow-ups, drop them here or ping me. :raised_hands:

devon (Eng): quick follow-up: can we confirm whether any customers were impacted by the regression? I’ll coordinate with CS.
maya (Product): CS confirms two customers saw elevated p95 but no errors; we alerted and followed up.
ops-bot: Thread archived to all-hands channel.
